description: Writes into fixed-point columns round to the COLUMN's scale: a bare NUMBER column is NUMBER(38,0), so an INSERT of 10.5 stores 11 and 2.71828 stores 3 (HALF_UP, away from zero for negatives), the INTEGER aliases behave the same, a scaled column rounds to its own scale and renders with it, FLOAT/DOUBLE columns keep the fraction, and UPDATE rounds exactly as INSERT does. Converted 1:1 from features/NumberColumnScaleRoundingTest (now retired).

steps.sql: SELECT LISTAGG(v, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v DESC) FROM nr_bare
SELECT LISTAGG(v, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v) FROM nr_scaled
